name: callable-throws
goal: Show Parameters, Returns and Throws tables for every callable, with descriptive source parameter names

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Callable contracts currently omit Throws when errors are absent and hide the parameter table for zero-argument functions. Each API should retain three tables and distinguish declared exceptions from no declared errors. Casing parameters should be named textToConvert.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing callable tests cover parameters and returns but never declared exceptions, exception ownership, or empty Throws tables. Extend their shared typed-contract fixture with a named TypeError and assert all three tables across revisions and screen widths.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed test 7af3cb12 fails because each callable does not expose a Throws table. Immutable red checkpoint and screenshots preserve the actual missing table.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Each callable retains Parameters, Returns and Throws tables, including explicit empty rows. Declared exceptions stay scoped to their function. Actual casing source parameters and contract fields are renamed textToConvert.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Same frozen tests and command pass at 554a8861. All three browser cases cover current and historical APIs at desktop, tablet and mobile widths, including declared TypeError ownership, empty Throws tables and zero parameters. Checkpoint 8b50de91.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports check passes formatting, types, lint, all 599 unit tests, builds and audit. Three frozen browser cases pass at three widths over tip and history, including error modal ownership. Nineteen root casing/field/generator/ownership tests pass; registry has no errors. Live renamed parameter and Throws tables inspected without browser errors. Root format/types/lint/Rust passed; root suite interrupted, Electron excluded.
